tools.name: search_venues
tools.description: Search every restaurant, bar and cafe in Greater Sudbury, Ontario that we track. Our own first-hand marks rank first, then fit, then public rating. Paid placement never affects order.

tools.name: get_venue
tools.description: Full record for one venue by id: hours, address, price, our mark and what to order or skip, public review summary, ratings, matching facts and sources.

tools.name: get_booking_links
tools.description: Links to reserve a table, open the venue's site, or find a nearby hotel. Links marked paid are affiliate links; they never affect order.
